steps.say: A flowering plant has four main parts: roots, stem, leaves and flowers. Each part has a job.

figure.alt: A flowering plant with roots, a stem, leaves and a flower.

steps.say: Roots grow down into the soil. They hold the plant still and take in water and minerals.
steps.show: roots: hold and take in water

steps.say: The stem holds the plant up towards the light. Tiny tubes inside carry water to the leaves.
steps.show: stem: holds up and carries water

steps.say: Leaves are wide and flat to catch light. They use light, air and water to make food.
Flowers attract insects with colour and smell. They make seeds that can grow into new plants.

figure.alt: A flower, a bee and a seed.

steps.say: Plants make their own food in their leaves. Roots take in water, not food.
steps.show: Roots take in water. Leaves make food.

check.prompt: Which part of a plant makes food?

options.why: Roots take in water. They are in the dark soil.
The stem holds the plant up and carries water.
Soil is not part of the plant. Plants make their own food.

hints: Which part spreads out to catch the light?
Think of a part that is wide, flat and green.
check.explanation: Leaves use light to make food for the plant.

check.prompt: Flowers make ___ that can grow into new plants.
hints: Think about what you plant in the ground.
Mango and chilli plants grow from these.
check.explanation: Flowers make seeds. A seed can grow into a new plant.
